scope: the derivation of steps from tactic nodes, i.e. the measured object, and the extractor module docstring that described it (no extractor code changes); the corpus, the counting formulas, the strata, and the hypotheses H10 and H11 are unchanged
observation: while validating amendment 1 on the five re-extracted modules (306 declarations), the derived graphs had 82 declarations with more than one root and the largest proof (UnificationStep.referenceLinksThreaded, 303 steps) had 19 roots, although a theorem has one statement goal. Two causes: (1) a goal produced by a non-leaf node was not recognised as produced, because only leaves counted as producers, so the continuation goal of `have h : T := by tac` was treated as an orphan and attributed to the enclosing tactic sequence, which became a bogus root step; (2) orphan goals were only attributed when a leaf consumed them, so the goal renamed by `case tag x y =>` and consumed by a non-leaf `cases ... with` had no producer. The steps, roots, and structure indices of these 306 declarations were inspected during the diagnosis; no other module was counted and the hypotheses were not evaluated on them.
change: steps are now derived from goal origins: a node produces the goals present after it and absent before it; the origin of a goal is the deepest producing node, or, for a goal no node produces, the deepest node enclosing its first mention that did not already hold it; a node is a step when it originates a goal or consumes a goal none of its descendants consumes; a step produces the goals it originates and consumes its own goals minus those consumed below it; dependencies point to origins. A `case tag x y =>` that renames its goal is therefore one step (it consumes the case goal and originates the renamed one); a plain `case tag =>` or `·` remains a container.
effectOnValidationSample: 306 declarations: single-root 224 -> 287; the remaining 19 multi-root declarations are term-mode matches whose alternatives are separate `by` blocks, derived instances (LawfulBEq, DecidableEq), and an `ext_iff` companion; the largest proof went from 303 steps, 19 roots, structure 0.732 to 291 steps, 1 root, structure 0.665; one declaration is a non-forest (an `exact` closing both the goal and a metavariable of an earlier `apply`)
